verdict: Ecolab grew sales 13% to $4.7B, powered by a 21% jump in Global Water after its CoolIT deal, but $81M of special charges and a much bigger interest bill pulled GAAP profit down 6% to $551M.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Sales were $4,695M, vs $4,165M a year ago; organic growth (excluding deals and currency) was 7%

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: Vs $2.05 a year ago; adjusted EPS was $2.18, up 5%

kpis.label: Global Water sales
kpis.note: Up 21% — the biggest segment got a lift from the Ovivo Electronics and CoolIT acquisitions

kpis.label: Special charges
kpis.note: Mostly acquisition and integration costs, booked inside operating costs

segments.name: Global Water
segments.note: Water treatment for heavy industry, food and beverage plants, paper mills and high-tech sites such as data centers and chip factories — growth was led by 63% organic growth in its high-tech business.

segments.name: Global Institutional & Specialty
segments.note: Cleaning and food-safety products and services for restaurants, hotels and food retail — steady growth despite weaker restaurant foot traffic in North America.

segments.name: Global Pest Elimination
segments.note: Pest-control services for food plants, restaurants and retailers — organic growth accelerated to 8%.

segments.name: Global Life Sciences
segments.note: Cleaning and contamination-control products for drug makers and labs — the smallest segment, and one of the fastest growing.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling the products and services and running the company — up 9% YoY.

opex.name: Special (gains) and charges
opex.note: One-off costs, primarily acquisition and integration costs for deals such as CoolIT (see one-time items).

otherDetail: Other was -$119M, net: $9M of other income, minus $125M of net interest expense (up sharply on debt taken on for acquisitions) and $3M of profit attributable to noncontrolling interests, which is deducted here so the flow lands on the $551M profit attributable to Ecolab.
oneTimers: Special charges of $81M in the quarter, primarily acquisition and integration costs. Leaving out these and similar items, Ecolab's adjusted operating income was $893M (up 14%) and adjusted EPS was $2.18 (up 5%), versus GAAP EPS of $1.95.
Corporate costs include $79M of amortization for acquired brands and technology — $28M from the Nalco merger, $21M from Purolite, $20M from CoolIT and $10M from Ovivo Electronics.
footerNote: Net income in the flow is the $551M attributable to Ecolab, the figure the release headlines; total net income including noncontrolling interests was $554M. Segment sales are the public-currency figures from the release's reportable segment table.

takeaways.title: Growth accelerated, led by Water
takeaways.text: Sales rose 13% to $4,695M, with organic growth accelerating to 7% — volume up 2% and pricing up 5%. Global Water sales jumped 21% to $2,481M as data-center and microelectronics demand drove 63% organic growth in its high-tech business, helped by the Ovivo and CoolIT deals.

takeaways.title: Underlying earnings rose
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS was $2.18, up 5%, and adjusted operating income rose 14% to $893M — despite an estimated 10% headwind from CoolIT acquisition costs. Ecolab guided full-year 2026 adjusted EPS to $8.10–$8.20, up 8–9%.

takeaways.title: GAAP profit still fell
takeaways.text: GAAP net income fell 6% to $551M and GAAP EPS fell 5% to $1.95. Special charges rose to $81M and net interest expense more than doubled to $125M on acquisition debt — the cost of the deal spree that is driving the growth.

follow100Note: Rows are rounded to the nearest cent per $100; the chain adds to $11.75 of profit per $100 versus the $11.74 shown, a 1-cent rounding difference.
